verdict.rationale: Okta documents event hooks: outbound HTTPS REST calls to a URL you specify, sent when specified events occur in your org. That gives event-driven triggering, but the action logic must be built and hosted externally. The evidence shows no native rule builder for defining conditions and in-platform actions. Missing for 10: native rule/condition definition, built-in automated actions without an external endpoint, in-depth docs on filtering and configuring triggers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
